verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the account-access goal and identifies the personal-profile integrity or authentication restriction blocking the existing Meta ad account.
First concrete failure of the proposed 2FA reset path: Advanced Protection prevented fully disabling two-factor authentication.
Distinct restoration-level failure after the blocked 2FA path: the freelancer reports that backend intervention by Meta is required and no alternative restoration solution is available.
First concrete post-escalation failure: Meta's appeal period had expired, so the existing-account restriction could not be restored through that support path.
